Name: Sushi Retexture
Author: sopfrnk
Description:
[img]http://live.staticflickr.com/65535/53375884992_1684ed98ec_o.png[/img]﻿

This mod retextures the sushi in the vanilla version of Stardew Valley to make it more realistic while still being consistent with the game style.

All assets have been created by me! 

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to work. Just place the downloaded files into the mods folder and the assets will update in every save.

Manifest.Name: Sushi Retexture
Manifest.Description: Changes the vanilla game sushi sprites
